LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED: the identity rule and route (b) are the owner's designed decision (task #1465 note of 2026-10-15) because the installation states no cue class (F14-D.7), so nothing here is verified_original; which of ZBD/soundsh.zbd and ZBD/soundsl.zbd the original opens is unmeasured, so the container is the labelled choice #1438 made; this is decoded-PCM evidence, not audible evidence — the F41-D listening test stays the owner's gate; and the composed run's world/presentation path needs CS_ENGINE_IMAGE (M01's player start), so this observation needs it too. The 2 assertion(s) discovered under this task's own prefix are the tests of this report. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
